script_text: Stop! Virgo, your Earth-sign ruler Mercury is rattling your private world. Mercury in Sagittarius in your 4th House squares Jupiter in Leo in your 12th House, so hidden expenses and overthinking can ambush home plans. Venus in Sagittarius trines Saturn in Aries in your 8th House, giving love and shared money a very serious, stable current. Mars in Scorpio in your 3rd House sharpens clear conversations, so don't let a careless text become a family argument. In love, a partner may want deeper commitment; if you're single, someone grounded may appear through family or a private circle. For career and money, avoid vague promises because Jupiter in your 12th House can inflate costs, but Mercury trine Saturn helps you negotiate practical terms. Protect your energy from dramatic relatives, and put every financial agreement in writing. Follow for tomorrow's Virgo reading.
